contracts.purpose: Separate new meanings from existing scalar/weighted-summary meanings
rules: Never infer a meaning from bare x/Q/F/Pi/G_F name
Legacy registered outputs retain numerical convention and explicit legacy definition_id
New outputs use namespace typefree_functionals_v1, subject to local acceptance
acceptance: Two same-named quantities with different definition_id cannot compare without explicit adapter
Round-trip preserves exact definition and provenance

contracts.purpose: Typed all-kinematics and observable tensor/functional carrier
rules: Reuse generic congruence first-jet decomposition; do not infer absent components from CMB scalars
A local observer boost and a physical congruence/global tilt have different quantity_id
Preserve rank/parity/basis and same-observation condition across comparison
Existing carrier adapters must explicitly bind tensor component ordering and units
acceptance: Minkowski constant congruence zero-kinematics limit
Coordinate/frame covariance with specified transformation
Unsupported component/window is typed unavailable, never zero-filled

rules: For each latent record evaluate its paired tensor, anchor and body; never Cartesian-multiply independent marginal draws
Reuse anchor_geometry supported body families
Gauge uses declared anchored coordinates and body; squared quadratic radius is not the gauge
Singular ellipsoid requires relative-span membership before inverse operation
Finite-dimensional zero-span result is NO_DIRECTIONS, not fabricated percentage
Report signed margin 1-gauge and optionally 100*(1-gauge); never clip and never call p-value
acceptance: Scalar interval reduces to registered scalar ratio only under matching definition
Known PD diagonal ellipsoid sqrt(x^T U^-1 x)
Rank-one body excludes a nullspace input; zero body/nonzero input has no finite gauge
Coupled constraints cannot silently use independent product-box upper bound as sharp joint bound

rules: Numerator and support use one body/frame/observation contract
Positive denominator condition explicit; zero/unsupported support has typed status
Do not confuse directional projection, tensor magnitude and squared norm
acceptance: Orthogonal frame rotation leaves corresponding scalar utilization invariant
Same norm, different direction may give different utilization for anisotropic body
Near-zero denominator produces declared status without arbitrary floor

rules: law_kind distinguishes posterior, sampling, null, empirical and confidence-set-image
Missing cross-covariance is unavailable unless independence is an explicit justified model assumption
A confidence-set image is coverage information, not posterior probability
Reject nonfinite/empty/misaligned arrays at the defined boundary; preserve explicit legacy semantics where necessary
No floor/synthetic weights may invent a scientific law
acceptance: Correlated vs independent joint samples give distinct transforms when expected
NaN denominator/numerator cannot return admitted OK summary
Joint coverage pushforward keeps source confidence statement and assumptions; no stronger coverage claim

rules: Optimize actual feasible fibers; ambient kernel arguments alone do not decide constrained-domain identifiability
Reuse existing fixed contraction support only for its fixed 3x7 STF3 domain
Unobserved/null directions do not acquire a physical magnitude estimate
Numerically unresolved rank/boundary remains unresolved
acceptance: Simple analytic 2D projection fiber reproduces known extrema
0D quotient produces NO_DIRECTIONS
Nonlinear constrained-domain example rejects unrestricted-kernel shortcut

rules: Preserve DepthRepresentation and full_covariance_blocks contracts

Do not auto-relabel existing floor-ratio G_F as signed tensor coherence

acceptance: Identity transport recovers same-frame result

Changing node order with corresponding full covariance/map permutation preserves result
